events.title: FESTAC@50
events.venueName: Multiple venues across Lagos: National Theatre, Tafawa Balewa Square, J. Randle Centre and Amuwo-Odofin
events.summary: Published programme materials list FESTAC@50 as a multi-venue Pan-African cultural festival running across Lagos from 26 December 2026 to 2 January 2027. Listed programme strands include the Opening Declaration, Pan-African Cultural & Creative Expo, FESTAC Dialogues, and the Unity Concert & Grand Closing Ceremony.
